adminPass.description:
Couchdb (i.e. fauxton) account with permission for all dbs and
tasks.

adminUser.description:
Couchdb (i.e. fauxton) account with permission for all dbs and
tasks.

argsFile.description: vm.args configuration. Overrides Couchdb's Erlang VM parameters file.

bindAddress.description: Defines the IP address by which CouchDB will be accessible.

configFile.description:
Configuration file for persisting runtime changes. File
needs to be readable and writable from couchdb user/group.

databaseDir.description:
Specifies location of CouchDB database files (*.couch named). This
location should be writable and readable for the user the CouchDB
service runs as (couchdb by default).

extraConfigFiles.description: Extra configuration files. Overrides any other configuration. You can use this to setup the Admin user without putting the password in your nix store.

group.description: Group account under which couchdb runs.

logFile.description: Specifies the location of file for logging output.

port.description: Defined the port number to listen.

uriFile.description:
This file contains the full URI that can be used to access this
instance of CouchDB. It is used to help discover the port CouchDB is
running on (if it was set to 0 (e.g. automatically assigned any free
one). This file should be writable and readable for the user that
runs the CouchDB service (couchdb by default).

user.description: User account under which couchdb runs.

viewIndexDir.description:
Specifies location of CouchDB view index files. This location should
be writable and readable for the user that runs the CouchDB service
(couchdb by default).
